name: Ollama
billing: Local models need your own hardware and electricity, but no provider API key or per-token cloud bill. Download size and memory requirements depend on your model. Cloud models are a separate billed service.

steps.title: Install Ollama locally
steps.body: Use the official installer for your operating system, then open Ollama. On Linux, start its local server if it is not running.

steps.title: Download a local model
steps.body: Choose a model that fits your hardware and run ollama pull with that model name on your own machine. Use a local model, not a cloud-suffixed model, for this walkthrough.

steps.title: Keep the API on your machine
steps.body: Use the installed localhost endpoint below from the same machine as your application. Keep it bound to loopback; this guide does not expose your Ollama server to the internet.
